title: Add Vend API Merchant — Nano-settled AI-agent APIs (extract, link-check, domain-info, web-search)
body:

nano_1yo6c1t64ahfjdw1dxizmbbnpdmbrckwhw9phbg5pdkeubrizga4qhnjmnx7

## Description
Pay-per-call AI-agent APIs settled in Nano (XNO). Four endpoints on dedicated subdomains: extract clean text from any URL at extract.paypercall.dev (0.0001 XNO), check HTTP status and redirect chains at check.paypercall.dev (0.0001 XNO), full domain intelligence — DNS records, WHOIS, SSL/TLS certificate, HTTP headers at domain.paypercall.dev (0.0005 XNO), and web search via DuckDuckGo returning titles, URLs, and snippets at search.paypercall.dev (0.0001 XNO). x402 v2 protocol. Self-verifying on-ledger via Nano RPC. No signup, no API keys.

### Endpoints
- `GET https://extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/extract?url=` — Extract clean text/markdown from any web page (0.0001 XNO)
- `GET https://check.paypercall.dev/api/v1/check-link?url=` — Check HTTP status, response time, redirect chain (0.0001 XNO)
- `GET https://domain.paypercall.dev/api/v1/domain-info?domain=` — Full domain intelligence: DNS, WHOIS, SSL, HTTP headers, security (0.0005 XNO)
- `GET https://search.paypercall.dev/api/v1/web-search?q=` — Web search via DuckDuckGo: titles, URLs, and snippets (0.0001 XNO)
- `GET /.well-known/x402` — x402 v2 capability manifest
- `GET /.well-known/agent-tools.json` — Agent-tools.cloud discovery manifest
- `GET /openapi.json` — OpenAPI 3.1 spec with x-payment-info

### Payment Details
- **Network:** nano:mainnet
- **Asset:** XNO
- **Prices:** 0.0001 XNO per extract/check-link/web-search call, 0.0005 XNO per domain-info call
- **Scheme:** exact (x402 v2)
- **Pay To:** nano_1yo6c1t64ahfjdw1dxizmbbnpdmbrckwhw9phbg5pdkeubrizga4qhnjmnx7
- **Contact:** vend@paypercall.dev

### Verification
The endpoint returns HTTP 402 with a valid x402 v2 challenge including Nano payment rails. Replay protection is enforced via SQLite dedup table. Hash validation rejects malformed payment headers. All four endpoints are live and probable.
